name: Nakazawa Akane
source:
"[url=/c115650]Mei-san[/url], I won't lose to you, okay!"

After graduating from high school, she moved to the city to pursue an idol career. She was able to join an agency without any difficulties, becoming a newcomer who debuted as a center of an idol group.

However, after refusing a big-shot producer casting couch invitations, her group was no longer invited to any shows, and spent their days waiting for job offers to come. All members in the group blamed her which made her feel awkward.

Due to her growing up in the countryside, she is kind-hearted and earnest, unfamiliar with the world around her. She is also simple-minded, often decides things on the spur of the moment. She isn't interested in love, and had never dated any man so far.

She met Mei when she joined the agency and looks up to her like she is her older sister. Despite their age difference, they got along really well and became good friends.

[Translated and edited from the [url=http://www.guilty-soft.com/product/namahaishin/#chara]Official website[/url]]
